display.purpose: Room mastheads and page titles, Bodoni Moda on the plate.

title.purpose: Entry and section titles on paper or plate.

body.purpose: Notes, captions and prose; small, plain, unromantic.

label.purpose: Table headers, eyebrows and section labels; tracked uppercase Archivo Narrow.

serial.purpose: Counterfoil serials, counts and record dates; tabular lining numerals.

motion.name: transition
motion.purpose: Default state transition for every interactive surface.

motion.name: press-seal
motion.purpose: The seal struck into an empty socket on approval (scale 1.6 → 0.94 → 1). Collapsed by prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Seal Act
components.description: The press — the one irreversible commit act. Solid oxblood; nothing else may look like this.
components.css: .ds-act-seal { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.125rem; background: var(--seal, #9e2b25); color: var(--paper, #efe7d6); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid var(--seal-deep, #6d1b17); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.12s linear; } .ds-act-seal:hover { background: var(--seal-bright, #d9564c); color: var(--plate, #0d1626); } .ds-act-seal:active { background: var(--seal-deep, #6d1b17); color: var(--paper, #efe7d6); } .ds-act-seal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp Act
components.description: Send back for rework — the hand-applied violet stamp.
components.css: .ds-act-stamp { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.125rem; background: transparent; color: var(--stamp-bright, #a184d4); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid var(--stamp-bright, #a184d4); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.12s linear; } .ds-act-stamp:hover { background: var(--stamp-wash, rgba(91,58,142,0.16)); } .ds-act-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Void Act
components.description: Cancellation — hover strikes the label through.
components.css: .ds-act-void { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.125rem; background: transparent; color: var(--plate-fg, #dcd6c8); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid var(--plate-rule, #24314c); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.12s linear; } .ds-act-void:hover { border-color: var(--plate-fg-soft, #949cac); text-decoration: line-through; }

components.name: Quiet Act
components.description: Secondary act on the plate; hover turns engraving-bright.
components.css: .ds-act-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.875rem; background: transparent; color: var(--plate-fg, #dcd6c8); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid var(--plate-rule, #24314c); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.12s linear; } .ds-act-quiet:hover { border-color: var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); color: var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); }

components.name: Mark
components.description: A rubber stamp, not a pill: transparent, bordered in its own ink.
components.html: Sealed Pending Stamped Ageing
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.1875rem 0.5rem; margin-right: 0.375rem; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; white-space: nowrap; background: transparent; } .ds-mark-sealed { color: var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); } .ds-mark-pending { color: var(--seal-bright, #d9564c); } .ds-mark-stamped { color: var(--stamp-bright, #a184d4); } .ds-mark-ageing { color: var(--sepia-bright, #d0a955); }

components.name: Seal Socket
components.description: Empty socket = waiting for JJ (dashed centre); sealed = radial oxblood wax, the one permitted gradient.
components.css: .ds-socket { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; margin-right: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--paper-edge, #c7bb9f); background: transparent; } .ds-socket-empty::after { content: ''; width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px dashed var(--paper-edge, #c7bb9f); } .ds-socket-sealed { border-color: var(--seal-deep, #6d1b17); background: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%, var(--seal-bright, #d9564c) 0%, var(--seal, #9e2b25) 46%, var(--seal-deep, #6d1b17) 100%); }

components.name: Document Card
components.description: A sheet of safety paper set into the plate, with laid-line texture and a hairline edge.
components.html:
Social · atto in attesa

Varicocele reel — caption review

Bozze, caption e patch ferme sul tuo giudizio.
components.css: .ds-document { background-color: var(--paper, #efe7d6); color: var(--paper-fg, #16202e); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(22,32,46,0.028) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px); border: 1px solid var(--paper-edge, #c7bb9f); border-radius: 0; padding: 20px; transition: all 0.12s linear; } .ds-document:hover { border-color: var(--engraving, #1f6f63); } .ds-doc-eyebrow { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--engraving-ink, #15564c); margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-doc-title { font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-doc-body { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--paper-fg-soft, #57606e); margin: 0; }

components.name: Register Input
components.description: Transparent field with a hairline border; focus turns the border engraving-bright. No fill, no radius.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--plate-rule, #24314c); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--plate-fg, #dcd6c8); outline: none; width: 100%; max-width: 380px; transition: all 0.12s linear; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--plate-fg-soft, #949cac); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); }

components.name: Navigation Row
components.description: Sidebar entry: 2px left border is the active device; engraving only, never oxblood.
components.html: AtrioEditorialPIF Tick
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--plate-deep, #070e1a); padding: 8px 0; width: 240px; } .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; padding: 8px 12px 8px 16px; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--plate-fg-soft, #949cac); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.12s linear, border-color 0.12s linear; } .ds-nav-row:hover { border-left-color: var(--engraving, #1f6f63); color: var(--plate-fg, #dcd6c8); } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { border-left-color: var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); background: var(--plate-raised, #16223a); color: var(--plate-fg-strong, #f4eee2); }

components.name: Filter Tab
components.description: Filters cut into the plate as underline tabs; active is an engraving-bright bottom border.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--plate-rule, #24314c); } .ds-filter { border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--plate-fg-soft, #949cac); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.12s linear; } .ds-filter:hover { color: var(--plate-fg, #dcd6c8); } .ds-filter-active, .ds-filter-active:hover { color: var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); border-bottom-color: var(--engraving-bright, #45b9a3); }

narrative.overview: This cockpit is the register the house is signed into, not a dashboard about it. It refuses the sidebar-plus-KPI-tiles-plus-filterable-table arrangement. The chrome of the whole application is intaglio blue-black plate; safety paper appears only where a real document sits; oxblood is reserved for the act of sealing and for what awaits JJ; violet stamps mark state applied by hand; sepia marks the thing quietly going stale. Depth is an engraved hairline, never a blur. The world was chosen as candidate 3 of the grounded list, seed key 9055bf41 — the full direction contract survives the production build as an HTML comment in app/layout.tsx. The story the interface tells: JJ reads which rooms want him from the counterfoil wall, opens that room's register, sees the asset at document scale, and seals it or sends it back.
keyCharacteristics: Intaglio plate chrome (#0d1626) with runtime-generated guilloche watermarks (a real hypotrochoid lathe, parameter-driven, never a texture image)
Safety paper (#efe7d6, laid-line textured) only under genuine document content
Square corners everywhere; circles exist only for genuinely circular seals and sockets
No drop shadows, no gradients (one exception: the wax of .socket-sealed), no pill badges
Bodoni Moda for document titles, Archivo Narrow for tracked-uppercase labels/acts/serials, Archivo for text
Tabular lining numerals in every register

rules.name: The Oxblood Rule
rules.body: --seal is reserved for the act of sealing and for what awaits JJ. Navigation, filters and selection states use engraving green. One decided exception: the login Sign-in act keeps .act-seal — signing into the register is itself a sealing act.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Safety paper appears only under real document content — a register table, an open document, a counterfoil stub. Chrome stays on the plate. A mute stub is plate-coloured and dashed: it never pretends to be paper it does not have.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals in registers are tabular lining: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums is applied globally to table and .tabular, and belongs on any column of figures.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Depth is an engraved hairline, never a blur. If a boundary needs more weight, it becomes a 3px double rule — the register's way of ruling off a section.

dos: Do keep oxblood for sealing and for what awaits JJ — the seal press, sealed wax, torn stubs, Il Cancello's gate, the toast — and give every other interaction to engraving green (The Oxblood Rule; the login Sign-in act is the one decided exception).
Do put safety paper only under real document content and keep all chrome on the plate (The Paper Rule).
Do set every count in tabular lining numerals (The Tabular Rule) and every label in Archivo Narrow tracked uppercase.
Do write "nessun riporto" on a surface with no reporting line — a mute stub is dashed and plate-coloured, and a number is never invented to fill it.
Do use hairlines for depth and 3px double rules for section weight (The Hairline Rule); overlays dim with --plate-deep opacity.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: the global override collapses all animation and transitions to 0.001ms.
Do keep guilloche decorative: pointer-inert, aria-hidden, sub-0.2 opacity.
donts: Don't round a corner: radius tokens are zeroed globally; rounded-full exists only for genuinely circular seals and sockets.
Don't cast a shadow — every shadow token is none; use an inset 1px ring or a hairline instead.
Don't use a gradient anywhere except the radial wax of .socket-sealed.
Don't make a pill badge: state is a bordered stamp (.mark), transparent with a 1px currentColor border.
Don't let anything that is not the commit act imitate .act-seal — solid oxblood is the press alone.
Don't ship filled-shape icons; icons are engraved line work at 1.25–1.5px strokes.
